newsitem.title: USA: Muni rally falls far short of Treasuries over week.
newsitem.headline: Muni rally falls far short of Treasuries over week.

text.p: Municipal bond yields fell between five and 10 basis points in the week ended Thursday, far short of the 20 basis point rally in Treasuries, Delphis Hanover Corp said on Friday.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields were five basis points lower, moving to 5.60 percent. Thirty-year Baa yields lost 10 basis points to 6.40 percent.
The Treasury long bond, in contrast, fell 21 basis points over the same period, dropping to 6.64 percent from 6.85 percent.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated bonds shed five basis points to 4.90 percent, and Baa-rated muni yields fell 10, to 5.65 percent.
Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated and Baa-rated municipal bonds both fell five basis points for the second consecutive week, to 3.65 percent and 4.45 percent, respectively.

The Aaa municipal yield curve was unchanged last week at 195, after steepening 10 basis points the prior week. The spread between one-year and 30-year Baa's, which steepened 15 basis points the prior week, flattened five last week to 195 basis points.

The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years was unchanged for the fifth consecutive week at 80 basis points. The 30-year spread narrowed five basis points to 80 basis points, reversing the prior week's widening.
